subject: Scope clarification: MedFlow prompt/output/log retention & purge request
messages:
From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@medflow.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: privacy@medflow.com
Date: 2027-08-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: retention scope + removal for MedFlow trial data (Req ID: MF-2027-4421)

Hi Grace,

We're moving forward with the data removal step for our trial tenant (MedFlow-qa-42). Legal sent over the attached deletion request form (Req ID MF-2027-4421). Before we sign off, we need to confirm the exact scope of what Redwood will remove when MedFlow requests prompt/output/log purging. Specifically: 

- Do "prompts" include user-provided system messages, user messages, and full request payloads?
- Are model-generated outputs (assistant responses) removed from all stores, including transient caches and long-term prompt-output logs?
- What runtime traces / request logs are retained vs. purged (e.g., timestamps, IPs, headers, response hashes)?

We prefer to retain anonymized usage metrics for billing reconciliation but require deletion of any PII or Protected Health Information (PHI) as defined in our form. Please confirm the expected timeframe for completion and the format of proof-of-execution you will provide.

Thanks,
Alex Ramos
Head of Platform Ops
MedFlow Health

Attachment: medflow_deletion_form.pdf

From: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@medflow.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-03T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: retention scope + removal for MedFlow trial data (Req ID: MF-2027-4421)

Alex — thanks for the form and the clear ask. Looping in Rishi from Ops (execution) and Marissa from CS (customer acceptance). A few clarifying Qs so we scope the work correctly before Rishi schedules the run: 

1) When you say "remove prompts," do you mean: 
   - a) user-provided message text stored in prompt logs and transcripts, and
   - b) cached KV/prefix cache entries used for repeated calls?

2) For "outputs", confirm whether you want all generated assistant responses deleted from:
   - a) per-request generation logs (token traces),
   - b) aggregated prompt-output artifacts retained for product analytics (we can anonymize),
   - c) embeddings or semantically derived artifacts (search index/embedding store).

3) For runtime logs, do you require full removal of request/response traces (including timestamps and non-PII headers) or redaction to remove PII/PHI only?

We can provision a scoped removal job for Hosted API tenants within 48-72 hours once scope is confirmed. For Dedicated or Private deployments the steps differ and may require a coordinated ops window. Rishi — can you provide the technical plan once Alex confirms scope?

Grace OcConnor
Principal Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@medflow.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-03T10:28:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: retention scope + removal for MedFlow trial data (Req ID: MF-2027-4421)

Thanks Grace. Alex — below is the ops-level plan and technical constraints. High level: we split artifacts into three buckets and treat each explicitly. 

1) Prompt & user message logs (text transcripts):
   - Hosted API: we will delete entries from the prompt-output log index and the transcript store. Deletion is immediate at the DB level; background compaction may take up to 24 hours to fully free disk space.
   - Dedicated/Private: we provide a playbook and can run the sweep on your appliance; customer must approve maintenance window.

2) Model-generated outputs (assistant responses / token traces):
   - We remove stored generation traces (token-level logs) and any linked artifacts in the prompt-output index.
   - If you use our evaluation/analytics pipeline we will remove associated rows and regenerate aggregate metrics to exclude deleted items. Aggregates (counts, latency percentiles) can be retained but will be annotated as "derived; non-PII" per your request.

3) Caches, embeddings, and KV state:
   - KV/prefix caches: ephemeral caches are flushed as part of the sweep. Persistent KV entries (customer-managed indexes, embedding stores) will be deleted if requested; note that embeddings used by shared indices may require a rebuild to maintain index integrity.

4) Runtime traces & request logs:
   - We can either fully delete traces (timestamps, request path, non-PII headers) or redact PII/PHI fields only. By default we redact PHI and keep anonymized telemetry for platform health. Full deletion will remove any request identifiers and make post-deletion debugging impossible for those requests.

Proof artifacts we provide after completion:
   - a) deletion run manifest with job id and affected object ids,
   - b) a signed statement of completion,
   - c) a link to a time-limited bundle containing sanitized traces (if requested) and the DB / index delete manifests.

Estimated timeline: once scope confirmed, ops run starts within 48 hours for hosted accounts and completes within 72 hours. Proof bundle available via secure link within 24 hours after completion.

Attachments: redaction_scope_matrix.xlsx (operations checklist mapping request types to stores and evidence).

--
Rishi Malhotra
Ops Engineering Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@medflow.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: privacy@medflow.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-04T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: retention scope + removal for MedFlow trial data (Req ID: MF-2027-4421)

Grace / Rishi — thanks for the quick reply and the plan. Confirming requested scope for MedFlow-qa-42: 

- Remove all user-provided messages (system/user/assistant conversation content) from prompt logs and transcript stores.
- Remove all model-generated outputs (assistant responses) and any token-level generation traces.
- Flush KV/prefix caches and delete any embedding vectors generated for this tenant.
- Delete runtime request traces associated with these requests (timestamps and request identifiers). We will retain only fully-aggregated and anonymized billing/usage metrics (no ability to reconstruct conversation-level content).

Please proceed under MF-2027-4421. We need proof-of-execution that lists the deleted object ids and a signed completion statement. Also confirm whether any third-party backups (cloud snapshots) will still retain copies and, if so, how Redwood handles backup retention in relation to deletion requests.

Alex Ramos
Head of Platform Ops
MedFlow Health

From: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@medflow.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-04T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: retention scope + removal for MedFlow trial data (Req ID: MF-2027-4421)

Alex — confirmed. We will execute MF-2027-4421 with the exact scope you outlined. Summary of commitments: 

- Scope: delete prompt transcripts, assistant outputs, token traces, KV/prefix caches, and embeddings tied to MedFlow-qa-42. Retain only aggregated non-reconstructable metrics for billing.
- Backups/snapshots: any managed cloud snapshots that may contain historical blobs are included in the sweep where possible. For immutable external backups we will provide a remediation plan and estimated purge timeline; Rishi will include snapshot keys in the manifest.
- Timeline: ops run scheduled within 48 hours; full completion and proof bundle within 72 hours of start.
- Evidence: signed deletion manifest (job id: REDWOOD-MF-4421-20270804), list of deleted object ids, and time-limited secure link to the sanitized proof bundle. DocuSign acceptance reference: 0b12-DFG34.

I'll mark the run and notify you at start + completion. If MedFlow legal needs a redline on the signed statement, loop in your counsel and we'll expedite.

Best,
Grace OcConnor
Principal Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redaction_scope_matrix.xlsx (ops checklist), medflow_deletion_form.pdf (accepted copy)
